outline: This course focuses on the design and evaluation of interactive systems from a human centered perspective. Students will learn about the theories and models of human cognitive processing with the consideration of task and enviroment characteristics; and students will learn how to apply design processes and evaluation techniques for improving system performance.
schedule:
Week 1-2: Using computers
Week 3-8: Designing interaction
Week 9-14: Facets of interaction
Week 15-16: Seminars
Week 17: 端午節
Week 18: Final project report and presentation
assessment:
Homeworks: 7%x10= 70%
Final Project Report & Presentation: 20%
Reports of Seminars: 5%x2= 10%
